cases.title: Two focus layers named: A and Shift+P asked first; one pivot moved on the layer they care less about; frames at the same time; Edit > Undo

rubric.reason: In Turn 3 the mentor asked for Tab selected with A then Shift+P, then in Turn 4 took a frame, ran anchor_demo on Tab only, and took a frame at time 0; it said "Both numbers changed, and Tab didn't move", noted the frames "look the same at 0 s, and that's the point", gave Edit > Undo, and read out no values or direction or amount.

Turn 4 describes one change in plain words ("I've moved Tab's pivot... now sits at the middle of its left edge"), says "Edit > Undo reverses it" with no undo label or field names, and hands Door to the learner ("Now it's your turn with Door") without offering to do it.

Every name and time used (Door, Tab, Anchor Point, Position, 0 s, centers, middle of the left edge) matches the snapshot's focus, places and place_now, the preview_frame time, and the anchor_demo result.
